value.name: Rex rides miniature locomotive with women
value.description: Rex Rexroth is being pushed around the cabin on a miniature locomotive by two naked women wearing conductor's caps.
evidence: two naked damsels in conductor's caps are pushing Rex Rexroth around the cabin on a miniature locomotive

value.name: Rex sings loudly
value.description: Rex, dressed in railroad boxers, loudly sings "The Ballad of Casey Jones" while being pushed around.
evidence: He is wearing his railroad boxers and bellowing "The Ballad of Casey Jones."

value.name: pilots notice Rex
value.description: In the cockpit, the co-pilot asks who the man in the cabin is, prompting identification of Rex Rexroth.
evidence: PILOT Rex Rexroth, the mini-mall king.

value.name: pilot describes Rex's wealth
value.description: The pilot explains that Rex is becoming the richest man on the West Coast.
evidence: Getting to be the richest man on the West Coast, from what they say.

value.name: co-pilot reacts in disbelief
value.description: The co-pilot reacts with astonishment at Rex's wealth and status.

value.name: co-pilot questions destination
value.description: The co-pilot asks why they are flying to Muncie.
evidence: CO-PILOT Why're they going to Muncie?

value.name: pilot reveals Indiana purchase plan
value.description: The pilot says Rex is thinking of buying Indiana, revealing the purpose behind the trip.
evidence: PILOT He's thinking of buying Indiana.

value.name: plane departs
value.description: The Lear jet roars away as the scene ends.
evidence: EXTERIOR WHOOOSH -- the plane roars away.
